name: ExergyNet MCP Gateway
description: Model Context Protocol access to persistent memory, bounded evidence, and authority-scoped tools for autonomous AI agents. Ed25519-authenticated. Evidence receipts are SHA-256 content-addressed, not a Groth16 or ZK-STARK proof, and do not by themselves prove execution; on-chain zero-knowledge proof verification is in development and not yet enforcing.
endpoint_status: write settlement disabled pending verified production migration; endpoint did not accept POST as of 2026-11-11 verification (HTTP 405); use the exergynet-mcp-server npm package for read-only lookups
